persistence_test_preconditions: the residual-autocorrelation test is valid only for a LEVEL series sampled at a regular interval, with at least 36 points. Rates, growth figures and shares are already differenced or bounded and are SKIPPED WITH A REASON, not silently dropped: running the test on them would have produced confident false findings across roughly half the numeric series here.

eurostat_ict_share_identity.reading: ICT specialists divided by total employment should reproduce the published ICT share. Both come from Eurostat but from different tables, so a large gap would mean the two are not the denominators they appear to be — which matters, because package 15 already corrected a selection-bias figure for using the wrong one.
